newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on disappointing exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on disappointing exports.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a bearish export sales number in USDA's weekly export sales report, traders said.
"Export sales this morning were disappointing," a trader said.
USDA early Thursday said net export sales of U.S. rice during the week ended January 30 totaled 13,800 tonnes. The market had expected at least 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes, traders said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 450 contracts, below the record 2,775 contracts traded Wednesday.
Rice closed one to 15 cents per cwt lower, with March down 13-1/2 at $11.87 per cwt.
